title: Side Hustle & Freelance Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:invoice
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most side hustle events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `freelance:invoice` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your side hustle data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
